FFmpeg WebAssembly media-filter preview

@ffmpeg/core 0.12.10
Copyright the FFmpeg authors and ffmpeg.wasm contributors.
License: GPL-2.0-or-later
License text: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/gpl-2.0.html
Corresponding upstream source, Dockerfile and build scripts:
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/v12.15
Core package: packages/core (version 0.12.10 in that release).
The FFmpeg WASM binary is unmodified. Zvid adapts the JavaScript command
wrapper to allocate command arguments on a temporary aligned stack and
restore the saved stack after each execution. This does not change filters.
